title: Richest American Men Live 14.6 Years Longer
hook: Income now separates entire decades of American life.
closing: The widening lifespan gap means prosperity can determine how much life people get.
question: What should close this gap?

segments.say: Richest American men outlive the poorest by 14.6 years. Income separates more than a decade of life.
Average American life expectancy rose 8.6 years. The income gap is larger than decades of nationwide progress.
The richest fifth gained 2.3 years of life. The poorest group barely advanced, widening the divide.
